profile.headline: 4+ Years’ Experience | Java Developer & Relational Banker  || @ Saint Louis University | Master’s in computer science with AI.
profile.summary:
About Me

I'm a full-stack developer and banking professional with a master's degree in computer science from St. Louis University, bringing 4+ years of experience in software development and 4+ years of banking experience as a relationship banker at Bank of India. I specialize in building scalable web applications and have strong experience in banking operations, customer relationship management, KYC/AML compliance, financial transactions, credit analysis, and risk management.

🔹 Professional Background
Currently, I work as a graduate research assistant at St. Louis University, contributing to software architecture, coding initiatives, and technology projects. Previously, I worked as a relationship banker at the Bank of India, where I managed customer accounts, banking operations, financial transactions, loan and credit activities, and regulatory compliance.

🔹 Technical Expertise
Languages & Frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, React.js, Node.js, Spring Boot
Cloud & Tools: AWS, GCP, GitHub, GitLab, Docker, Netlify
Testing & DevOps: Jest, CircleCI, CI/CD Pipelines
Business & CRM: Salesforce, Zendesk, Customer Relationship Management
Banking: Banking Operations, Account Management, KYC/AML, Credit Analysis, Risk Management, Financial Transactions, Customer Service
Specialties: SaaS Applications, Agile/Scrum, Cloud Hosting, API Integration, Software Architecture, Software Development Lifecycle, Banking & Financial Services

🔹 Open to Opportunities
I'm actively seeking opportunities where I can combine my software engineering, AI, and banking experience to solve complex problems and build impactful technology solutions. I'm particularly interested in roles that value innovation, continuous learning, collaboration, and customer-focused development.

🔹 Let's Connect!

I'm always open to connecting with technology and banking professionals, sharing knowledge, and exploring opportunities and collaborations. Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn or reach out via email to discuss technology, banking, opportunities, or potential projects.

projects.title: Data-Driven Healthcare Analytics Platform
projects.description:
Developed a platform to analyze healthcare data and provide predictive analytics for patient care.

Key Features:
Predictive models for patient readmission rates.
Interactive dashboards for real-time data insights.
Data anonymization and compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Impact: Helped hospitals reduce readmission rates by 20% and optimize resource allocation.

projects.title: AI-Driven Smart Energy Management System
projects.description:
Developed a system that integrates IoT with artificial intelligence to optimize energy usage in smart homes. The system predicts energy consumption patterns and dynamically adjusts device operations to reduce costs and carbon footprint.

Key Features: Predictive analytics for energy usage, integration with renewable energy sources, and dynamic load balancing across devices.
Technologies: IoT sensors, AI models (TensorFlow), Raspberry Pi, AWS IoT Core, and a custom dashboard built with React.
Impact: Reduced household energy bills by 40% and supported sustainable energy practices.
